note: Bill's own curated list of movies to watch with his whole family — a separate category from the solo recommendation flow. Each entry's titleKey also exists in candidatePool.json (source: family-watch-list) so it gets real TMDB enrichment (poster/genre/overview) for free, and in feedbackData.json with excludeFromRecommendations so it never surfaces in the solo You'll Love panels or competes for a candidate-pool cap slot. releaseDate and streaming are real, hand-researched fields (via WebSearch against real outside sources, never guessed) — TMDB has no reliable field for either, especially forward-looking VOD/streaming dates, so this mirrors the same discipline trakt/data/upcomingSeasons.json already established for renewal status.
